verses: Alif Laam Meem
Allah Taalaa woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, jo zindah aur sab ka nigehbaan hai
Jiss ney aap per haq kay sath uss kitab ko nazil farmaya hai, jo apney say pehlay ki tasdeeq kerney wali hai, ussi ney uss say pehlay Taurat aur Injeel ko utara tha

Uss say pehlay, logon ko hidayat kerney wali bana ker, aur Quran bhi ussi ney utara, jo log Allah Taalaa ki aayaton say kufur kertay hain unn kay liye sakht azab hai aur Allah Taalaa ghalib hai, badla lenay wala hai
Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa per zamin o aasman ki koi cheez posheedah nahi
Woh maa kay pet mein tumhari soorten jiss tarah chahata hai banata hai. Uss kay siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi woh ghalib hai, hikmat wala hai

O hi Allah Taalaa hai jiss ney tujh per kitab utari jiss mein wazeh mazboot aayaten hain jo asal kitab hain baaz mutashabeh aayaten hain. Pus jin kay dilon mein kuji hai woh to uss ki mutashabeh aayaton kay peechay lag jatay hain, fitney ki talab aur unn ki murad ki justujoo kay liye, halankay unn kay haqeeqi murad ko siwaye Allah Taalaa kay koi nahi janta aur pukhta o mazboot ilm walay yehi kehtay hain kay hum to unn per eman chukay, yeh humaray rab ki taraf say hain aur naseehat to sirf aqalmand hasil kertay hain.
Aey humaray rab! humen hidayat denay kay baad humaray dil tairhay na kerdey aur humen apney pass say rehmat ata farma, yaqeenan to hi boht bari ata denay wala hai
Aey humaray rab! to yaqeenan logon aik din jama kerney wala hai jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa wada khilafi nahi kerta
Kafiron ko unn kay maal aur unn ki aulad Allah Taalaa (kay azab) say churaney mein kuch kaam na aayen gi, yeh to jahannum ka endhan hi hain
Jaisa aal Firaun haal hua, aur unn ka jo unn say pehlay thay, unhon ney humari aayaton jhutlaya, phir Allah Taalaa ney bhi unhen unn kay gunahon per pakar liya, aur Allah Taalaa sakht azab wala hai
Kafiron say keh dijiye! kay tum unqareeb maghloob kiye jao gay aur jahannum ki taraf jama kiye jao gay aur woh bura thikana hai

Yaqeenan tumharay liye ibrat ki nishani thi unn do jamaton mein jo guth gaee thin, aik jamat to Allah Taalaa ki raah mein larr rahi thi aur doosra giroh kafiron ka tha woh unhen apni aankhon say apney say dugna dekhtay thay aur Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye apni madad say qavi kerta hai. Yaqeenan uss mein aankhon walon kay liye bari ibrat hai

Marghoob cheezon ki mohabbat logon kay liye muzayyan ker di gaee hai, jaisay aurten aur betay aur soney aur chandi kay jama kiye huye khazaney aur nishandaar ghoray aur chopaye aur kheti, yeh duniya ki zindagi ka saman hai aur lotney ka acha thikana to Allah Taalaa hi kay pass hai

Aap keh dijiye! kiya mein tumhen uss say boht hi behtar cheez bataon? Taqwa walon kay liye unn kay rab Taalaa kay pass jannaten hain jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha rahen gay aur pakeezah biwiyan aur Allah Taalaa ki razamandi hai, sab banday Allah Taalaa ki nigah mein hain
Jo kehtay hain kay aey humaray rab! hum eman laa chukay uss liye humaray gunah moaf farma aur humen aag kay azab say bacha
Jo sabar kerney walay aur sach bolney walay aur farmanbardari kerney walay aur Allah ki raah mein kharach kerney walay aur pichli raat ko bakhsish mangney walay hain

Allah Taalaa, farishtay aur ahl ilm uss baat ki gawahi detay hain kay Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi aur woh adal ko qaeem rakhney wala hai, uss ghalib aur hikmat walay kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi

Bey shak Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek deen islam hi hai, aur ahl kitab ney apney pass ilm aajaney kay baad aapas ki sirkashi aur hasad ki bana per hi ikhtilaf kiya hai aur Allah Taalaa ki aayaton kay sath jo bhi kufur keray Allah Taalaa uss ka jald hisab lenay wala hai

Phir bhi agar yeh aap say jhagren to aap keh den kay mein aur meray tabeydaron ney Allah Taalaa kay samney apna sir tasleem khum ker diya hai aur ahl kitab say aur un-parh logon say keh dijiye! kay kiya tum bhi ita’at kertay ho? Pus agar yeh bhi tabeydaar bann jayen to yaqeenan hidayat walay hain aur agar yeh roo-gardani keren, to aap per sirf phoncha dena hai aur Allah bandon ko khoob dekh bhaal raha hai

Jo log Allah Taalaa ki aayaton say kufur kertay hain aur na-haq nabiyon ko qatal ker daaltay hain aur jo log adal o insaf ki baat kahen unhen bhi qatal ker daaltay hain, to aey nabi! unhen dard-naak azab ki khabar dijiye
Unn kay aemaal duniya o aakhirat mein ghaarat hain aur unn ka koi madadgar nahi

Kiya aap ney unhen nahi dekha jinhen aik hissa kitab ka diya gaya hai woh apney aapas kay faislon kay liye Allah Taalaa ki kitab ki taraf bulaye jatay hain, phir bhi aik jamat unn ki mun pher ker lot jati hai
Uss ki wajah unn ka yeh kehna kay humen to ginay chuney chand din hi aag jalaye gi, unn ki garhi garhai baaton ney unhen unn kay deen kay baray mein dhokay mein daal rakha hai
Pus kiya haal hoga jabkay hum unhen uss din jama keren? Jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi aur her shakhs apna apna kiya poora poora diya jaye ga aur unn per zulm na kiya jaye ga

Aap keh dijiye aey Allah! aey tamam jahaan kay malik! to jissay chahaye badshahi dey aur jiss say chahaye saltanat cheen ley aur to jissay chahaye izzat dey jissay chahaye zillat dey, teray hi hath mein sab bhalaiyan hain, bey shak to her cheez per qadir hai

To hi raat ko din mein dakhil kerta hai aur din ko raat mein ley jata hai, to hi bey jaan say jaandaar peda kerta hai aur to hi jaandaar say bey jaan peda kerta hai, to hi hai kay jissay chahata hai bey shumar rozi deta hai

Mominon ko chahaiye kay eman walon ko chor ker kafiron ko apna dost na banayen aur jo aisa keray ga woh Allah Taalaa ki kissi himayat mein nahi magar yeh kay unn kay shar say kissi tarah bachao maqsood ho, aur Allah Taalaa khud tumhen apni zaat say dara raha hai aur Allah Taalaa hi ki taraf lot jana hai

Keh dijiye! kay khuwah tum apney seenon ki baaten chupao khuwah zahir kero Allah Taalaa (bahar) janta hai, aasmano aur zamin mein jo kuch hai sab ussay maloom hai aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Jiss din her nafs (shakhs) apni ki hui nekiyon ko aur apni ki hui buraiyon ko mojood paley ga, aarzoo keray ga kay kaash! uss kay aur buraiyon kay darmiyan boht hi doori hoti. Allah Taalaa tumhen apni zaat say dara raha hai aur Allah Taalaa apney bandon per bara hi meharban hai

Keh dijiye! agar tum Allah Taalaa say mohabbat rakhtay ho to meri tabeydaari kero, khud Allah Taalaa tum say mohabbat keray ga aur tumharay gunah moaf farma dey ga aur Allah Taalaa bara bakhshney wala meharban hai
Keh dijiye! kay Allah Taalaa aur rasool ki ita’at kero, agar yeh mun pher len to bey shak Allah Taalaa kafiron say mohabbat nahi kerta
Bey shak Allah Taalaa ney tamam jahaan kay logon mein say Adam (alaihi as-salam) ko aur Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko, Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kay khandan aur imran kay khandan ko muntakhib farma liya
Kay yeh sab aapas mein aik doosray ki nasal say hain aur Allah Taalaa sunta janta hai

Jab imran ki biwi ney kaha kay aey meray rab! meray pet mein jo kuch hai, ussay mein ney teray naam aazad kerney ki nazar mani, to meri taraf say qabool farma! yaqeenan to khoob sunnay wala aur poori tarah jannay wala hai

Jab bachi ko jana to kehney lagen kay perwerdigar! mujhay to larki hui, Allah Taalaa ko khoob maloom hai kay kiya aulad hui hai aur larka larki jaisa nahi mein ney uss ka naam Maryam rakha, mein ussay aur uss ki aulad ko shetan mardood say teri panah mein deti hun

Pus ussay uss kay perwerdigar ney achi tarah qabool farmaya aur ussay behtareen perwerish di. Uss ki khair khabar lenay wala Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) ko banaya, jab kabhi Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) unn kay hujray mein jatay unn kay pass rozi rakhi hui patay, woh poochtay aey Maryam! yeh rozi tumharay pass kahan say aaee? Woh jawab detin kay yeh Allah Taalaa kay pass say hai, bey shak Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye bey shumar rozi dey
Ussi jagah Zakariya (alaihi as-salam) ney apney rab say dua ki, kaha kay aey meray perwerdigar! mujhay apney pass say pakeezah aulad ata farma, bey shak to dua ka sunnay wala hai

Pus farishton ney unhen awaz di, jab kay woh hujray mein kharay namaz parh rahey thay, kay Allah Taalaa tujhay yahya ki yaqeeni khushkhabri deta hai jo Allah Taalaa kay kalma ki tasdeeq kerney wala, sardar, zaabit nafs aur nabi hai nek logon mein say
Kehney lagay aey meray rab! meray haan bacha kaisay hoga? Mein bilkul boorha ho gaya hun aur meri biwi baanjh hai, farmaya, ussi tarah Allah Taalaa jo chahaye kerta hai

Kehney lagay perwerdigar! meray liye uss ki koi nishani muqarrar ker dey, farmaya, nishani yeh hai kay teen din tak to logon say baat na ker sakay ga, sirf isharay say samjhaye ga, to apney rab ka zikar kasrat say ker aur subha o shaam ussi ki tasbeeh biyan kerta reh
Aur jab farishton ney kaha, aey Maryam! Allah Taalaa ney tujhay bargazeedah ker liya aur tujhay pak ker diya aur saray jahaan ki aurton mein say tera intikhab ker liya
Aey Maryam! to apney rab ki ita’at ker aur sajdah ker aur rukoo kerney walon kay sath rukoo ker

Yeh ghaib ki khabron mein say hai jissay hum teri taraf wahee say phonchatay hain, to unn kay pass na tha jab kay woh apney qalam daal rahey thay kay Maryam ko unn mein say kaun paley ga? Aur na to unn kay jhagarney kay waqt unn kay pass tha

Jab farishton ney kaha aey Maryam Allah Taalaa tujhay apney aik kalmay ki khushkhabri deta hai jiss ka naam maseeh Isa bann Maryam hai jo duniya aur aakhirat mein izzat hai aur woh meray muqarrabeen mein say hai
Woh logon say apney gehwaray mein baaten keray ga aur adher umar mein bhi aur woh nek logon mein say hoga

Kehney lagen elahi mujhay larka kaisay hoga? Halankay mujhay to kissi insan ney hath bhi nahi lagaya, farishtay ney kaha, ussi tarah Allah Taalaa jo chahaye peda kerta hai, jab kabhi woh kissi kaam ko kerna chahta hai to sirf yeh keh deta hai kay ho jaa! to woh ho jata hai
Allah Taalaa ussay likhna aur hikmat aur Taurat injeel sikhaye ga

Aur woh bani israeel ki taraf rasool hoga, kay mein tumharay pass tumharay rab ki nishani laya hun, mein tumharay liye parinday ki shakal ki tarah mitti ka parinda banata hun, phir uss mein phoonk maarta hun to woh Allah Taalaa kay hukum say parinda bann jata aur Allah Taalaa kay hukum say mein maadar andhay ko aur korhi ko acha ker deta hun aur murdon ko zindah kerta hun aur jo kuch tum khao aur jo apney gharon mein zakheera kero mein tumhen bata deta hun, uss mein tumharay liye bari nishani hai, agar tum eman laney walay ho

Aur mein Taurat ki tasdeeq kerney wala hun jo meray samney hai aur mein uss liye aaya hun kay tum per baaz woh cheezen halal keroon jo tum per haram ker di gaee hain aur mein tumharay pass tumharay rab ki nishani laya hun, uss liye tum Allah Taalaa say daro aur meri farmanbardari kero
Yaqeen mano! mera aur tumhara rab Allah hi hai, tum sab ussi ki ibadat kero, yehi seedhi raah hai

Magar jab hazrat Isa alaihi as-salam ney unn ka kufur mehsoos ker liya to kehney lagay Allah Taalaa ki raah mein meri madad kerney wala kaun kaun hai? Hawariyon ney jawab diya kay hum Allah Taalaa ki raah kay madadgar hain, hum Allah Taalaa per eman laye aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum tabeydaar hain
Aey humaray paalney walay mabood! hum teri utari hui wahee per eman laye aur hum ney teray rasool ki ittabaa ki, pus to humen gawahon mein likh ley
Aur kafiron ney makar kiya aur Allah Taalaa ney bhi (makar) khufiya tadbeer ki aur Allah Taalaa sab khufiya tadbeer kerney walon say behtar hai

Jab Allah Taalaa ney farmaya kay aey Isa! mein tujhay poora lenay wala hun aur tujhay apni janib uthaney wala hun aur tujhay kafiron say pak kerney wala hun aur teray tabeydaron ko kafiron kay upper ghalib kerney wala hun qayamat kay din tak, phir tum sab ka lotna meri hi taraf hai mein hi tumharay aapas kay tamam tar ikhtilafaat ka faisla keroon ga
Phir kafiron ko to mein duniya aur aakhirat mein sakht tar azab doon ga aur unn ka koi madadgar na hoga
Lekin eman walon aur nek aemaal walon ko Allah Taalaa unn ka sawab poora poora dey ga aur Allah Taalaa zalimon say mohabbat nahi kerta
Yeh jissay hum teray samney parh rahey hain aayaten hain aur hikmat wali naseehat hain
Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek Isa (alaihi as-salam) ki misal ho bahu Adam (alaihi as-salam) ki misal hai jissay mitti say bana ker kay keh diya kay ho jaa! pus woh ho gaya
Teray rab ki taraf say haq yehi hai khabardaar shak kerney walon mein na hona

Uss liye jo shakhs aap kay pass uss ilm kay aajaney kay baad bhi aap say uss mein jhagray to aap keh den kay aao hum tum apney apney farzandon ko aur hum tum apni apni aurton ko aur hum tum khaas apni apni janon ko len, phir hum aajzi kay sath iltija keren aur jhooton per Allah ki laanat keren
Yaqeenan sirf yehi sacha biyan hai aur koi mabood bar-haq nahi ba-juz Allah Taalaa kay aur bey shak ghalib aur hikmat wala Allah Taalaa hi hai
Phir bhi agar qabool na keren to Allah Taalaa bhi sahih tor per fasadiyon ko jannay wala hai

Aap keh dijiye kay aey ahl kitab! aisi insaf wali baat ki taraf aao jo hum mein tum mein barabar hai kay hum Allah Taalaa kay siwa kissi ki ibadat na keren na uss kay sath kissi ko shareek banayen, na Allah Taalaa ko chor ker aapas mein aik doosray ko hi rab banayen. Pus agar woh mun pher len to tum keh do kay gawah raho hum to musalman hain
Aey ahl kitab! tum Ibrahim ki babat kiyon jhagartay ho halankay Taurat o Injeel to unn kay baad nazil ki gaeen, kiya tum phir bhi nahi samajhtay?
Suno! tum log uss mein jhagar chukay jiss ka tumhen ilm tha phir abb uss baat mein kiyon jhagartay ho jiss ka tumhen ilm hi nahi? Aur Allah Taalaa janta hai aur tum nahi jantay,
Ibrahim to na yahudi thay na nasrani thay balkay)yeh woh to yak tarfa (khalis) musalman thay, woh mushrik bhi nahi thay,
Sab logon say ziyadah Ibrahim say nazdeek tar woh log hain jinhon ney unn ka kaha mana aur yeh nabi aur jo log eman laye, mominon ka o li aur sahara Allah hi hai,
Ahl kitab ki aik jamat chahati hai kay tumhen gumrah ker den. Dar-asal woh khud apney aap ko gumrah ker rahey hain aur samajhtay nahi
Aey ahl kitab tum (bawajood qaeel honey kay phir bhi) daanista Allah ki aayaat ka kiyon kufur ker rahey ho?
Aey ahl kitab! bawajood jannay kay haq o baatil ko kiyon khalat malat ker rahey ho aur kiyon haq ko chupa rahey ho?
Aur ahl kitab ki aik jamat ney kaha kay jo kuch eman walon per utara gaya hai uss per din charhay to eman lao aur shaam kay waqt kafir bann jao, takay yeh log bhi palat jayen

Aur siwaye tumharay deen per chalney walon kay aur kissi ka yaqeen na kero. Aap keh dijiye kay bey shak hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai (aur yeh bhi kehtay hain kay uss baat ka bhi yaqeen na kero) kay koi uss jaisa diya jaye jaisa tum diye gaye ho, ya yeh kay yeh tum say tumharay rab kay pass jhagra keren gay, aap keh dijiye kay fazal to Allah Taalaa hi kay hath mein hai, woh jissay chahaye ussay dey, Allah Taalaa wusat wala janney wala hai
Woh apni rehmat kay sath jissay chahaye makhsoos ker ley aur Allah Taalaa baray fazal wala hai

Baaz ahl kitab to aisay hain kay agar unhen to khazaney ka amin bana dey to bhi woh tujhay wapis ker den aur unn mein say baaz aisay bhi hain kay agar to unhen aik dinar bhi amanat dey to tujhay ada na keren. Haan yeh baat hai kay to uss kay sir per hi khara rahey, yeh uss liye kay unhon ney keh rakha hai kay hum per unn jahilon (ghair yahudi) kay haq koi gunah nahi, yeh log bawajood jannay kay Allah Taalaa per jhoot kehtay hain
Kiyon nahi (moakhiza hoga) albatta jo shakhs apna qarar poora keray aur perhezgari keray, to Allah Taalaa bhi aisay perhez gaaron say mohabbat kerta

Bey shak jo log Allah Taalaa kay ehad aur apni qasmon ko thori qeemat per baich daaltay hain, unn kay liye aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi, Allah Taalaa na to unn say baat cheet keray ga na unn ki taraf qayamat kay din dekhay ga, na unhen pak keray ga aur unn kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Yaqeenan mein aisa giroh bhi hai jo kitab parhtay huye apni zaban marorta hai takay tum ussay kitab hi ki ibarat khayal kero halankay dar-asal woh kitab mein say nahi, aur yeh kehtay bhi hain kay woh Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai halankay dar asal woh Allah Taalaa ki taraf say nahi, woh to daanista Allah Taalaa per jhoot boltay hain

Kissi aisay insan ko jissay Allah Taalaa kitab o hikmat aur naboowat dey, yeh laeeq nahi kay phir bhi woh logon say kahey kay tum Allah Taalaa ko chor ker meray banday bann jao, balkay)yeh woh to kahey ga kay tum sab rab kay ho jao, tumharay kitab sikhaney kay baees aur tumharay kitab parhney kay sabab.
Aur yeh nahi (ho sakta) kay woh tumhen farishton nabiyon ko rab bana lenay ka hukum keray, kiya woh tumharay musalman honey kay baad bhi tumhen kufur ka hukum dey ga

Jab Allah Taalaa ney nabiyon say ehad liya kay jo kuch mein tumhen kitab o hikmat doon phir tumharay pass woh rasool aaye jo tumharay pass ki cheez ko sach bataye to tumharay liye uss per eman lana aur uss ki madad kerna zaroori hai. Farmaya kay tum uss kay iqrari ho aur uss per mera zimmay ley rahey ho? Sab ney kaha kay humen iqrar hai, farmaya to abb gawah raho aur khud mein bhi tumharay sath gawahon mein hun
Pus uss kay baad bhi jo palat jayen woh yaqeenan pooray nafarman hain.

Kiya woh Allah Taalaa kay deen kay siwa aur deen ki talash mein hain? Halankay tamam aasmano walay aur sab zamin walay Allah Taalaa hi kay farmanbardar hain khushi say hun ya khushi say, sab ussi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay

Aap keh dijiye kay hum Allah Taalaa per aur jo kuch hum per utara gaya hai aur jo kuch Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) aur Ismail (alaihi as-salam) aur Yaqoob (alaihi as-salam) aur unn ki aulad per utara gaya aur jo kuch Musa o Isa (alaihima as-salam) aur doosray anbiya (alaihim as-salam) Allah Taalaa ki taraf say diye gaye, unn sab per eman laye, hum unn mein say kissi kay darmiyan farq nahi kertay aur hum Allah Taalaa kay farmanbardar hain
Jo shakhs islam kay siwa aur deen talash keray, uss ka deen qabool na kiya jaye ga aur woh aakhirat mein nuksan paney walon mein hoga

Allah Taalaa unn logon ko kaisay hidayat dey ga jo apney eman laney aur rasool ki haqqaniyat ki gawahi denay aur apney pass roshan daleelen aajaney kay baad kafir ho jayen, Allah Taalaa aisay bey insaf logon ko raah raast per nahi laata
Unn ki to yehi saza hai kay unn per Allah Taalaa ki aur farishton ki aur tamam logon ki laanat ho
Jiss mein yeh hamesha paray rahen gay, na to unn say azab halka kiya jaye ga na unhen mohlat di jaye gi
Magar log uss kay baad tauba aur islaah ker len to bey shak Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai
Be-shak jo log apney eman laney kay baad kufur keren phir kufur mein barh jayen, unn ki tauba hergiz hergiz qabool na ki jaye gi, yehi gumrah log hain

Haan jo log kufur keren aur martay dum tak kafir rahen unn mein say koi agar zamin bhar sona dey, go fidiye mein hi ho to bhi hergiz qabool na kiya jaye ga. Yehi log hain jin kay liye takleef denay wala azab hai aur jin ka koi madadgar nahi
Jab tak tum apni pasandeedah cheez say Allah Taalaa ki raah mein kharach na kero hergiz bhalaee na pao gay, aur tum jo kharach kero ussay Allah Taalaa bakhoobi janta hai

Taurat kay nuzool say pehlay (hazrat) Yaqoob (alaihi as-salam) ney jiss cheez ko apney upper haram ker liya tha uss kay siwa tamam khaney bani israeel per halal thay, aap keh dijiye kay agar tum sachay ho to Taurat ley aao aur parh ker sunao
Uss kay baad bhi jo log Allah Taalaa per jhoot bohtan bandhen o hi zalim hain
Keh dijiye kay Allah Taalaa sacha hai tum sab Ibrahim hanif kay millat ki pairwee kero, jo mushrik na thay
Allah Taalaa ka pehla ghar jo logon kay liye muqarrar kiya gaya o hi hai jo Makkah (sharif) mein hai jo tamam duniya kay liye barkat o hidayat wala hai

Jiss mein khulli khulli nishaniyan hain, muqam Ibrahim hai, uss mein jo aa jaye aman wala ho jata hai Allah Taalaa ney unn logon per jo uss ki taraf raah paa saktay hun uss ghar ka hajj farz ker diya gaya hai. Aur jo koi kufur keray to Allah Taalaa (uss say balkay)yeh) tamam duniya say bey perwah hai
Aap keh dijiye kay aey ahl kitab tum Allah Taalaa ki aayaton kay sath kufur kiyon kertay ho? Jo kuch tum kertay ho, Allah Taalaa uss per gawah hai
Unn ahl kitab say kaho kay tum Allah Taalaa ki raah say logon ko kiyon roktay ho? Aur uss mein aib tatoltay ho, halankay tum khud shahid ho, Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal say bey khabar nahi
Aey eman walo! agar tum ahl kitab ki kissi jamat ki baaten mano gay to woh tumhen tumharay eman laney kay baad murtid kafir bana den gay.

)go yeh zahir hai kay (tum kaisay kufur ker saktay ho? Bawajood yeh kay tum per Allah Taalaa ki aayaten parhi jati hain aur tum mein rasool Allah) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (mojood hain. Jo shakhs Allah Taalaa (kay deen) ko mazboot thaam ley to bila-shuba ussay raah raast dikha gaee
Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa say itna daro jitna uss say darna chahaiye aur dekho martay dum tak musalman hi rehna

Allah Taalaa ki rasi ko sab mill ker mazboot thaam lo aur phoot na dalo, aur Allah Taalaa ki uss waqt ki nemat ko yaad kero jab tum aik doosray kay dushman thay, to uss ney tumharay dilon mein ulfat daal di, pus tum uss ki meharbani say bhai bhai hogaye, aur tum aag kay garhay kay kinaray phonch chukay thay to uss ney tumhen bacha liya. Allah Taalaa ussi tarah tumharay liye apni nishaniyan biyan kerta hai takay tum hidayat pao
Tum mein say aik jamat aisi honi chahaiye jo bhalaee ki taraf bulaye aur nek kaamon ka hukum keray aur buray kaamon say rokay, aur yehi log falah o nijat paney walay hain
Tum unn logon ki tarah na ho jana jinhon ney apney pass roshan daleelen aa janey kay baad bhi tafarrqa dala, aur ikhtilaf kiya, unhen logon kay liye bara azab hai
Jiss din baaz chehray safaid hun gay aur baaz siyah, siyah chehray walon (say kaha jaye ga) kay kiya tum ney eman laney kay baad kufur kiya? Abb apney kufur ka azab chakho
Aur safaid chehray walay Allah Taalaa ki rehmat mein dakhil hun gay aur uss mein hamesha rahen gay
Aey nabi! hum unn haqqani aayaton ki tilawat aap per ker rahey hain aur Allah Taalaa ka iradah logon per zulm kerney ka nahi
Allah Taalaa hi kay liye hai jo kuch aasmano aur zamin mein hai aur Allah Taalaa hi ki taraf tamam kaam lotaye jatay hain

Tum behtareen ummat ho jo logon kay liye peda ki gaee hai kay tum nek baaton ka hukum kertay ho aur buri baaton say roktay ho, aur Allah Taalaa per eman rakhtay ho, agar ahl kitab bhi eman latay to unn kay liye behtar tha, unn mein eman walay bhi hain lekin aksar to fasiq hain
Yeh tumhen sataney kay siwa aur ziyadah kuch zarar nahi phoncha saktay, agar laraee ka moqa aajaye to peeth mor len gay, phir madad na kiye jayen gay

Unn per her jagah zillat ki maar pari, illa yeh kay Allah Taalaa ki ya logon ki panah mein hun, yeh ghazab elahi kay mustahiq ho gaye aur unn per faqeeri daal di gaee, yeh uss liye kay yeh log Allah Taalaa ki aayaton say kufur kertay thay aur bey wajah anbiya ko qatal kertay thay, yeh badla hai unn ki farmaniyon aur ziyadtiyon ka
Yeh saray kay saray yaksan nahi balkay)yeh unn ahl kitab mein aik jamat (haq per) qaeem rehney wali bhi hai jo raaton kay waqt bhi kalaam Allah ki tilawat kertay hain aur sajday bhi kertay hain

Yeh Allah Taalaa per qayamat kay din per eman bhi rakhtay hain, bhalaiyon ka hukum kertay hain aur buraiyon say roktay hain aur bhalaee kay kaamon mein jaldi kertay hain. Yeh nek bakht logon mein say hain
Yeh jo kuch bhi bhalaiyan keren unn ki qadri na ki jaye gi aur Allah Taalaa perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai
Kafiron ko unn kay maal aur unn ki aulad Allah kay haan kuch kaam na aayen gi, yeh to jahannumi hain jo hamesha ussi mein paray rahen gay

Yeh kuffaar jo kharach ikhraajaat keren uss ki misal yeh hai kay aik tund hua chali jiss say pala tha jo zalimon ki kheti per para aur ussay tehus nehus ker diya. Allah Taalaa ney unn per zulm nahi kiya balkay)yeh woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay thay

Aey eman walo! tum apna dili dost eman walon kay siwa aur kissi ko na banao. (tum to) nahi dekhtay doosray log tumhari tabahi mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhtay, woh to chahatay hain kay tum dukh mein paro unn ki adawat to khud unn ki zaban say bhi zahir ho chuki hai aur jo unn kay seenon mein posheedah hai woh boht ziyadah hai, hum ney tumharay liye aayaten biyan ker den

Agar aqalmand ho (to ghor kero) haan tum to unhen chahatay ho aur woh tum say mohabbat nahi rakhtay, tum poori kitab ko mantay ho, (woh nahi mantay phir mohabbat kaisi?) yeh tumharay samney to apney eman ka iqrar kertay hain lekin tanahi mein maaray ghussa kay ungliyan chabatay hain keh do kay apney ghussa hi mein marr jao, Allah Taalaa dilon kay raaz ko bakhoobi janta hai

Tumhen agar bhalaee milay to yeh khush hotay hain haan! agar buraee phonchay to khush hotay hain, tum agar sabar kero aur perhezgari kero to unn ka makar tumhen kuch nuksan na dey ga. Allah Taalaa ney unn kay aemaal ka ehaata ker rakha hai

Aey nabi! uss waqt ko bhi yaad kero jab subha hi subha aap apney ghar say nikal ker musalmanon ko maidan jang mein laraee kay morchon per ba-qaeeda bitha rahey thay Allah Taalaa sunnay jannay wala hai
Jab tumhari do jamaten pust himmati ka iradah ker chuki thin, Allah Taalaa unn ka o li aur madadgar hai. Aur ussi ki pak zaat per mominon ko bharosa rakhna chahaiye

Jang badar mein Allah Taalaa ney ain uss waqt tumhari madad farmaee thi jab kay tum nihayat giri hui halat mein thay, uss liye Allah hi say daro! (na kissi aur say) takay tumhen shukar guzari ki tofiq ho
(aur yeh shukar guzari baees nusrat o imdad ho) jab aap mominon ko tasalli dey rahey thay, kiya aasman say teen hazar farishtay utaar ker Allah Taalaa ka tumhari madad kerna tumhen kafi na hoga,
Kiyon nahi, balkay)yeh agar tum sabar o perhezgari kero aur yeh log ussi dum tumharay pass aajayen to tumhara rab tumhari imdad paanch hazar farishton say keray ga jo nishandaar hun gay
Aur yeh to mehaz tumharay dil ki khushi aur itminan qalb kay liye hai, werna madad to Allah hi ki taraf say hai jo ghalib aur hikmaton wala hai
(uss imdad elahi ka maqsad yeh tha kay Allah) kafiron ki aik jamat ko kaat dey ya unhen zaleel ker dalay aur (saray kay saray) murad ho ker wapis chalay jayen
Aey payghumbar! aap kay ikhtiyar mein kuch nahi, Allah Taalaa chahaye to unn ki tauba qabool keray ya azab dey, kyunkay woh zalim hain
Aasmano aur zamin mein jo kuch hai sab Allah hi ka hai, woh jissay chahaye bakhshay jissay chahaye azab keray, Allah Taalaa bakhsish kerney wala meharban hai
Aey eman walo! barha charha ker sood na khao, aur Allah Taalaa say daro takay tumhen nijat milay
Aur uss aag say daro jo kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai
Aur Allah aur uss kay rasool ki farmanbardari kero takay tum per reham kiya jaye
Aur apney rab ki bakhsish ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf doro jiss ka arz aasmano aur zamin kay barabar hai, jo perhezgaron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai

Jo log aasani mein sakhti kay moqay per bhi Allah kay raastay mein kharach kertay hain, ghussa peenay walay aur logon say darguzar kerney walay hain, Allah Taalaa unn nek kaaron say mohabbat kerta hai

Jab unn say koi shaista kaam ho jaye ya koi gunah ker bethen to foran Allah ka zikar aur apney gunahon kay liye istaghfaar kertay hain, fil-waqey Allah Taalaa kay siwa aur kaun gunahon ko bakhsh sakta hai? Aur woh log bawajood ilm kay kissi buray kaam per arr nahi jatay
Unhen ka badla unn kay rab ki taraf say maghfirat hai aur jannaten hain jin kay neechay nehren behti hain, jin mein woh hamesha rahen gay, unn nek kaamon kay kerney walon ka sawab kiya hi acha hai
Tum say pehlay bhi aisay waqiyaat guzar chukay hain, so zamin mein chal phir ker dekh lo kay (aasmani taleem kay) jhutlanay walon ka kiya anjam hua?
Aam logon kay liye to yeh (Quran) biyan hai aur perhezgaron kay liye hidayat o naseehat hai
Tum na susti kero aur ghumgeen ho, tum hi ghalib raho gay, agar tum emandar ho

Agar tum zakhmi huye ho to tumharay mukhalif log bhi to aisay hi zakhmi ho chukay hain, hum unn dino ko logon kay darmiyan adaltay badaltay rehtay hain. (shikast Uhud) uss liye thi kay Allah Taalaa eman walon ko zahir kerdey aur tum mein say baaz ko shahdat ka darja ata farmaye, Allah Taalaa zalimon say mohabbat nahi kerta
(yeh wajah bhi thi) kay Allah Taalaa eman walon ko bilkul alag ker dey aur kafiron ko mita dey
Kiya tum yeh samajh bethay ho kay tum jannat mein chalay jao gay, halankay abb tak Allah Taalaa ney yeh zahir nahi kiya kay tum say jihad kerney walay kaun hain aur sabar kerney walay kaun hain?
Jang say pehlay to tum shahdat ki aarzoo mein thay abb ussay apni aankhon say apney samney dekh liya

(hazrat) Muhammad) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (sirf rasool hi hain, unn say pehlay boht say rasool ho chukay hain, kiya agar unn ka intiqal ho jaye ya yeh shaheed ho jayen, to tum islam say apni aeriyon kay bal phir jao gay? Aur jo koi phir jaye apni aeriyon per to hergiz Allah Taalaa ka kuch na bigaray ga, unqareeb Allah Taalaa shukar guzaron ko nek badla dey ga

Baghair Allah Taalaa kay hukum kay koi jaandaar nahi sakta, muqarrar shuda waqt likha hua hai, duniya ki chahat walon ko hum kuch duniya dey detay hain aur aakhirat ka sawab chahaney walon ko hum woh bhi den gay. Ehsan mannay walon ko hum boht jald nek badla den gay

Boht say nabiyon kay hum rakaab ho ker, boht say Allah walay jihad ker chukay hain, unhen bhi Allah ki raah mein takleefen phonchin lekin na to unhon ney himmat haari na sust rahey aur na dabay, aur Allah sabar kerney walon ko (hi) chahata hai

Woh yehi kehtay rahey kay aey perwerdigar! humaray gunahon ko bakhsh dey aur hum say humaray kaamon mein jo bey jaa ziyadti hui hai ussay bhi moaf farma aur humen sabit qadmi ata farma aur humen kafiron ki qom per madad dey
Allah Taalaa ney unhen duniya ka sawab bhi diya aur aakhirat kay sawab ki khoobi bhi ata farmaee aur Allah Taalaa nek logon say mohabbat kerta hai
Aey eman walo! agar tum kafiron ki baaten mano gay to woh tumhen tumhari aeriyon kay bal palta den gay, (yani tumhen murtid bana den gay) phir tum murad ho jao gay
Balkay)yeh Allah hi tumhara mola hai aur o hi behtareen madadgar hai

Hum unqareeb kafiron kay dilon mein rob daal den gay, uss wajah say kay yeh Allah kay sath unn cheezon ko shareek kertay hain jiss ki koi daleel Allah ney nahi utari, unn ka thikana jahannum hai, aur unn zalimon ki buri jagah hai

Allah Taalaa ney tum say apna wada sacha ker dikhaya jabkay tum uss kay hukum say unhen kaat rahey thay. Yahan tak kay jab tum ney pust himmati ikhtiyar ki aur kaam mein jhagarney lagay aur na-farmani ki, uss kay baad kay uss ney tumhari chahat ki cheez tumhen dikha di, tum mein say baaz duniya chahatay thay aur baaz ka iradah aakhirat ka tha to phir uss ney tumhen unn say pher diya takay tum ko aazmaye aur yaqeenan uss ney tumhari laghzish say darguzar farma diya aur eman walon per Allah Taalaa baray fazal wala hai

Jab kay tum charhay chalay jaa rahey thay aur kissi taraf tawajja tak nahi kertay thay aur Allah kay rasool tumhen tumharay peechay say aawazen dey rahey thay, bus tumhen ghum per ghum phoncha takay tum fot shuda cheez per ghumgeen na ho aur na phonchney wali (takleef) per udas ho, Allah Taalaa tumharay tamam aemaal say khabardaar hai

Phir uss ney uss ghum kay baad tum per aman nazil farmaya aur tum mein say aik jamat ko aman ki neend aaney lagi. Haan kuch woh log bhi thay kay unhen apni janon ki pari hui thi, woh Allah Taalaa kay sath na-haq jahalat bhari bad-gumaniyan ker rahey thay aur kehtay thay kiya humen bhi kissi cheez ka ikhtiyar hai? Aap keh dijiye kay kaam kul ka kul Allah kay ikhtiyar mein hai, yeh log apney dilon kay bhed aap ko nahi batatay, kehtay hain kay agar humen kuch bhi ikhtiyar hota to yahan qatal na kiye jatay. Aap keh dijiye kay go tum apney gharon mein hotay phir bhi jin ki qismat mein qatal hona tha woh to maqtal ki taraf chal kharay hotay, Allah Taalaa ko tumharay seenon kay andar ki cheez ka aazmana aur jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai, uss ko pak kerna tha, aur Allah Taalaa seenon kay bhed say aagah hai

Tum mein say jin logon ney uss din peeth dikhaee jiss din dono jamaton ki bher hui thi yeh log apney baaz kartooton kay baees shetan kay phuslaney mein aagaye lekin yaqeen jano kay Allah Taalaa ney unhen moaf ker diya Allah Taalaa hai bakhshney wala aur tahammul wala

Aey eman walo! tum unn logon ki tarah na ho jana jinhon ney kufur kiya aur apney bhaiyon kay haq mein jab kay woh safar mein hun ya jihad mein hun, kaha kay agar yeh humaray pass hotay to na martay aur na maaray jatay, uss ki wajah yeh thi kay uss khayal ko Allah Taalaa unn ki dili hasrat ka sabab bana dey, Allah Taalaa jilata hai aur maarta hai aur Allah tumharay amal ko dekh raha hai
Qasam hai agar Allah Taalaa ki raah mein shaheed kiye jao ya apni maut maro to bey shak Allah Taalaa ki bakhsish o rehmat uss say behtar hai jissay yeh jama ker rahey hain
Bil-yaqeen khuwah tum marr jao ya maar dalay jao jama to Allah Taalaa ki taraf hi kiye jao gay.

Allah Taalaa ki rehmat kay baees aap unn per naram dil hain aur agar aap bad zaban aur sakht dil hotay to yeh sab aap kay pass say chatt jatay, so aap unn say darguzar keren aur unn kay liye istaghfaar keren aur kaam ka mashwara unn say kiya keren, phir jab aap ka pukhta iradah ho jaye to Allah Taalaa per bharosa keren, bey shak Allah Taalaa tawakkal kerney walon say mohabbat kerta hai

Agar Allah Taalaa tumhari madad keray to tum per koi ghalib nahi sakta aur agar woh tumhen chor dey to uss kay baad kaun hai jo tumhari madad keray? Eman walon ko Allah Taalaa hi per bharosa rakhna chahaiye

Na-mumkin hai kay nabi say khayanat ho jaye her khayanat kerney wala khayanat ko liye huye qayamat kay din hazir hoga, phir her shakhs ko apney aemaal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga, aur woh zulm na kiye jayen gay
Kiya pus woh shakhs jo Allah Taalaa ki khushnoodi kay darpay hai, uss shakhs jaisa hai jo Allah Taalaa ki narazgi ley ker lot’ta hai? Aur jiss ki jagah jahannum hai jo bad-tareen jagah hai
Allah Taalaa kay pass unn kay alag alag darjay hain aur unn kay tamam aemaal ko Allah bakhoobi dekh raha hai

Bey shak musalmanon per Allah Taalaa ka bara ehsan hai kay unn hi mein say aik rasool unn mein bheja, jo unhen uss ki aayaten parh ker sunata hai aur unhen pak kerta hai aur unhen kitab aur hikmat sikhata hai, yaqeenan yeh sab uss say pehlay khulli gumrahi mein thay

(kiya baat hai) kay jab tumhen aik aisi takleef phonchi kay tum uss jaisi do chand phoncha chukay, to yeh kehney lagay kay yeh kahan say aagaee? Aap keh dijiye kay yeh khud tumhari taraf say hai, bey shak Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Aur tumhen jo kuch uss din phoncha jiss din do jamaton mein mudd bheer hui thi, woh sab Allah kay hukum say tha aur uss liye kay Allah Taalaa eman walon ko zahiri tor per jaan ley

Aur munafiqon ko bhi maloom ker ley jin say kaha gaya kay aao Allah ki raah mein jihad kero, ya kafiron ko hatao, to woh kehney lagay kay agar hum laraee jantay hotay to zaroor sath detay, woh uss din ba nisbat eman kay kufur say boht qareeb thay, apney mun say woh baaten banatay hain jo unn kay dilon mein nahi, aur Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai jissay woh chupatay hain

Yeh woh log hain jo khud bhi bethay rahey aur apney bhaiyon ki babat kaha kay agar woh bhi humari baat maan letay to qatal na kiye jatay. Keh dijiye! kay agar tum sachay ho to apni janon say maut ko hata do
Jo log Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye hain unn ko hergiz murdah na samjhen, balkay)yeh woh zindah hain apney rab kay pass roziyan diye jatay hain

Allah Taalaa ney apna fazal jo unhen dey rakha hai uss say boht khush hain aur khushiyan mana rahey hain unn logon ki babat jo abb tak unn say nahi milay unn kay peechay hain, uss per kay unhen na koi khof hai aur na woh ghumgeen hun gay
Woh khush hotay hain Allah ki nemat aur fazal say aur uss say bhi kay Allah Taalaa eman walon kay ajar ko barbaad nahi kerta
Jin logon ney Allah aur rasool kay hukum ko qabool kiya uss kay baad kay unhen pooray zakham lag chukay thay, unn mein say jinhon ney neki ki aur perhezgari barti unn kay liye boht ziyadah ajar hai

Woh log kay jab unn say logon ney kaha kay kafiron ney tumharay muqablay per lashkar jama ker liye hain, tum unn say khof khao to uss baat ney unhen eman mein aur barha diya aur kehney lagay humen Allah kafi hai aur woh boht acha kaarsaaz hai
(nateeja yeh hua kay) Allah ki nemat o fazal kay sath yeh lotay, unhen koi buraee na phonchi, unhon ney Allah Taalaa ki razamandi ki pairwee ki, Allah boht baray fazal wala hai
Yeh khabar denay wala sirf shetan hi hai jo apney doston say darata hai tum unn kafiron say na daro aur mera khof rakho, agar tum momin ho

Kufur mein aagay barhney walay log tujhay ghumnaak na keren, yaqeen mano kay yeh Allah Taalaa ka kuch na bigar saken gay, Allah Taalaa ka iradah hai kay unn kay liye aakhirat ka koi hissa ata na keray, aur unn kay liye bara azab hai
Kufur ko eman kay badlay khareedney walay hergiz hergiz Allah Taalaa ko koi nuksan nahi phoncha saktay aur unn hi kay liye alamnaak azab hai
Kafir log humari di hui mohlat ko apney haq mein behtar na samjhen, yeh mohlat to uss liye hai kay woh gunahon mein aur barh jayen, unn hi kay liye zaleel kerney wala azab hai

Jiss haal mein tum ho ussi per Allah eman walon ko na chor dey ga jab tak kay pak aur pak ko alag alag na ker dey, aur na Allah Taalaa aisa hai kay tumhen ghaib say aagah kerdey, balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa apney rasoolon mein say jiss ka chahaye intikhab ker leta hai, uss liye tum Allah Taalaa per aur uss kay rasoolon per eman rakho, agar tum eman lao aur taqwa kero to tumharay liye bara bhari ajar hai

Jinhen Allah Taalaa ney apney fazal say kuch dey rakha hai woh uss mein apni kanjoosi ko apney liye behtar khayal na keren balkay)yeh woh unn kay liye nihayat badtar hai, unqareeb qayamat walay din yeh apni kanjoosi ki cheez kay toq dalay jayen gay, aasmano aur zamin ki meeras Allah Taalaa hi kay liye aur jo kuch tum ker rahey ho, uss say Allah Taalaa aagah hai

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ney unn logon ka qol bhi suna jinhon ney kaha kay Allah Taalaa faqir hai aur hum toongar hain unn kay uss qol ko hum likh len gay. Aur unn ka anbiya ko bula wajah qatal kerna bhi, aur hum unn say kahen gay kay jalney wala azab chakho
Yeh tumharay paish kerdah aemaal ka badla hai aur Allah Taalaa apney bandon per zulm kerney wala nahi

Yeh woh log hain jinhon ney kaha kay Allah Taalaa ney humen hukum diya hai kay kissi rasool ko na manen jab tak woh humaray pass aisi qurbani na laye jissay aag kha jaye. Aap keh dijiye kay agar tum sachay ho to mujh say pehlay tumharay pass jo rasool deegar moajzon kay sath yeh bhi laye jissay tum keh rahey ho to phir tum ney unhen kiyon maar dala?
Phir bhi agar yeh log aap ko jhutlayen to aap say pehlay bhi boht say rasool jhutlaye gaye hain jo roshan daleelen saheefay aur munawar kitab ley ker aaye

Her jaan maut ka maza chakhney wali hai aur qayamat kay din tum apney badlay pooray pooray diye jao gay, pus jo shakhs aag say hata diya jaye aur jannat mein dakhil ker diya jaye bey shak woh kaamyaab hogaya, aur duniya ki zindagi to sirf dhokay ki jinss hai

Yaqeenan tumharay maalon aur janon say tumhari aazmaeesh ki jaye gi aur yeh bhi yaqeen hai kay tumhen unn logon ki jo tum say pehlay kitab diye gaye aur mushrikon ki boht si dukh denay wali baaten bhi sunni paren gi aur agar tum sabar ker lo aur perhezgari ikhtiyar kero to yaqeenan yeh boht bari himmat ka kaam hai

Aur Allah Taalaa ney jab ahl kitab say ehad liya kay tum ussay sab logon say zaroor biyan kero gay aur ussay chupao gay nahi, to phir bhi unn logon ney uss ehad ko apni peeth peechay daal diya aur ussay boht kum qeemat per baich dala. Unn ka yeh beopaar boht bura hai

Woh log jo apney kartooton per khush hain aur chahatay hain kay jo unhon ney nahi kiya uss per bhi unn ki tareefen ki jayen aap unhen azab say chutkara mein na samjhiye unn kay liye to dard-naak azab hai
Aasmano aur zamin ki badshahi Allah hi kay liye hai aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Aasmano aur zamin ki pedaeesh mein aur raat din kay hair pher mein yaqeenan aqalmandon kay liye nishaniyan hain

Jo Allah Taalaa ka zikar kharay aur bethay aur apni kerwaton per letay huye kertay hain aur aasmano o zamin ki pedaeesh mein ghor-o-fikar kertay hain aur kehtay hain aey humaray perwerdigar! tu ney yeh bey faeedah nahi banaya, to pak hai pus humen aag kay azab say bacha ley
Aey humaray paalney walay! to jissay jahannum mein dalay yaqeenan tu ney ussay ruswa kiya, aur zalimon ka madadgar koi nahi

Aey humaray rab! hum ney suna kay munadi kerney wala ba-aawaz buland eman ki taraf bula raha hai kay logo! apney rab per eman lao, pus hum eman laye. Ya elahi abb to humaray gunah moaf farma aur humari buraiyan hum say door ker dey aur humari maut nekon kay sath ker
Aey humaray paalney walay mabood! humen woh dey jiss ka wada tu ney hum say apney rasoolon ki zabani kiya hai aur humen qayamat kay din ruswa na ker, yaqeenan to wada khilafi nahi kerta

Pus unn kay rab ney unn ki dua qabool farma kay tum mein say kissi kaam kerney walay kay kaam ko khuwah woh mard ho ya aurat mein hergiz zaya nahi kerta, tum aapas mein aik doosray kay hum jinss ho, uss liye woh log jinhon ney hijrat ki aur apney gharon say nikal diye gaye aur jinhen meri raah mein ezza di gaee aur jinhon ney jihad kiya aur shaheed kiye gaye, mein zaroor zaroor unn ki buraiyan unn say door ker doon ga aur bil-yaqeen unhen unn jannaton mein ley jaon ga jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain, yeh hai sawab Allah Taalaa ki taraf say aur Allah Taalaa hi kay pass behtareen sawab hai
Tujhay kafiron ka shehron mein chalna phirna fareb mein na daal dey,
Yeh to boht hi thora faeedah hai, uss kay baad unn ka thikana to jahannum hai aur woh buri jagah hai

Lekin jo log apney rab say dartay rahey unn kay liye jannaten hain jin kay neechay nehren jari hain, unn mein woh hamesha rahen gay yeh mehmani hai Allah ki taraf say aur nek kaaron kay liye jo kuch Allah Taalaa kay pass hai woh boht hi behtar hai

Yaqeenan ahl kitab mein say baaz aisay bhi hain jo Allah Taalaa per eman latay hain aur tumhari taraf jo utara gaya hai aur unn ki janib jo nazil hua uss per bhi, Allah Taalaa say dartay hain aur Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ko thori thori qeemat per baichtay bhi nahi, unn ka badla unn kay rab kay pass hai, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa jald hisab lenay wala hai
Aey eman walo! tum sabit qadam raho aur aik doosray ko thamay rakho aur jihad kay liye tayyar raho aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho takay tum murad ko phoncho
